combo_label: Moving House × The Allotment × Gilbert & Sullivan

entries.clue: Shallow boat-shaped wooden basket carried down the rows at picking time
Army rank above brigadier, boasting information vegetable, animal and mineral
Satin circle laid beside the best three carrots on the trestle
Charges for the legal work, piled on top of the price of the house
Scarlet-flowered climbing bean, or the creeping stalk a strawberry throws
1887 opera whose ancestral portraits step out of their frames
Line of a form you change with the bank, the doctor and the taxman
Refrain of the suicidal bird's ballad that melts a fearsome lady's heart
Fine crumbly state of a raked surface, worked up before you sow
Rented unit on an industrial estate where surplus belongings wait
